name: patient_is_child_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently classified as a child according to standard clinical definitions.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently classified as a child according to standard clinical definitions (typically under 18 years of age, but may vary by context).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently classified as a child.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's age or child status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
